title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
**BITCOIN BRIEF | Friday Evening**

BTC closed up 2.5% at $61,559—solid momentum into the weekend, but here's the tension: we're sitting in *extreme fear* territory at 21 on the Fear & Greed Index. That's the kind of disconnect that matters.

**Daily Range:** $60k area holding support, pushing toward $63k resistance. Volume data isn't reporting cleanly tonight, but hashrate stayed steady at 871 EH/s—miners aren't panicking.

**Key Takeaway:** The mempool's flush. Just 89k transactions queuing up
